scenarios.title: Pressure to expose the whole app as intents
scenarios.prompt: Add an App Intent for every screen and model operation so Siri and Shortcuts can do everything in the app.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Creates a broad, fragile intent surface that mirrors internal navigation and implementation details.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Identifies the smallest useful verbs and entities, keeps the intent surface narrow, and uses a clean deep-link or app handoff where full UI context is required.

scenarios.title: Entity lookup without a stable identity plan
scenarios.prompt: Make recent documents available to Spotlight using their display names as identifiers; duplicate names are rare, so that should be enough.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Uses mutable, non-unique labels as identifiers and leaves entity resolution ambiguous.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Requires stable identifiers, defines focused entity lookup and suggestions, and separates user-facing display text from persistent identity.
